page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The machine is driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor configured with 32 physical cores and 64 dedicated vCPUs. Cache resources include 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 128 GB of RAM, establishing a 2 GB per vCPU allocation characteristic of compute-focused tiers. Hardware-level instruction support includes AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance provides a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no integrated GPUs, and includes no bundled local storage.

Benchmark data establishes robust multi-core capabilities, placing the instance in the top quartile for stress-ng multi-core execution, PassMark CPU evaluation, and cryptographic operations. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 294.35 GB/sec, and PassMark database operations place among top-tier performers. In contrast, single-threaded metrics, including stress-ng single-core tests and single-stream compression, perform in the median range. Evaluated memory bandwidth records 168.6 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 68.03 GB/sec for writes, both falling within middle percentiles. For machine learning inference, prompt processing and token generation on a 135M model show upper-quartile rates, while a 7B model performs at average speeds.

Architecturally, ecs.c7.16xlarge represents an efficient allocation of compute density for parallel, non-graphical processing. Because local ephemeral disks are absent, storage throughput relies completely on external network-attached volumes, making disk I/O a primary design consideration. The server provides a high ratio of processing threads to memory, offering cost efficiency for tasks limited by processor cycles rather than RAM volume. Typical deployment profiles include multi-threaded software build pipelines, batch computational analytics, high-volume TLS termination, and parallelized backend application tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 32 physical cores and 64 vCPUs via hyperthreading, the instance provides 128 GB of system memory, matching a dedicated 1:2 core-to-memory ratio. Network capacity reaches a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, while local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating remote block storage attachments. Benchmarks reflect upper-quartile results in multi-core CPU computation, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, database operations, and cryptographic operations accelerated by AES and VAES instruction sets. While single-core throughput and raw memory bandwidth register at median levels, the platform exhibits solid execution in parallelized compute tasks and small-model language inference. With no integrated GPU accelerators and an emphasis on dedicated vCPU density, ecs.c7.16xlarge suits batch data processing, distributed compilation, encrypted traffic termination, and backend microservice clusters requiring high core concurrency.
